name: intelligence-knowledge-graph
summary: Experimental provenance-aware graph reference model linking source records, preserved evidence, public entities and evidence-backed relationships. It does not collect data or make autonomous identity assertions.

license.notes: Scoped mixed-license strategy; file-level provenance and third-party license review remains open.

evidence.claim: Local tests exercise graph model, provenance and bounded query behavior; they do not establish production collection, authenticity or trusted custody.
